verdicts.rationale: The REST v2 API correctly returns error code 100 ('collection not found') when attempting to create an index on a non-existent collection. This is expected by-design behavior - a collection must exist before an index can be created on it. Both REST API and Python SDK properly enforce this prerequisite. The defect claim appears to be based on an incorrect expectation that index creation should succeed without the collection existing, which violates basic API semantics.
